note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = dial centre of the straightened photo (pipeline/seiko_snxs75_rectify.py). Plan sizes from the trace (36.8 mm case, Irsyad); heights are the SNKL50K1/SNK607K1 values (no side view). Steel case and bracelet, gold indices, hands and day-date frame with lume. SEIKO, the 5 shield, the print, the minute ticks and the marker at 3 stay in the dial map.

case.profile_note: wide polished bezel: flat top to 16.9 mm, then a slope down to the gasket (the grey band in the photo)

bracelet.columns_note: [x0, x1 as a fraction of the half width, row phase in pitches, material]: brushed centre links half a row off the brushed outer links (photo)
bracelet.pitch_note: first outer row next to the end link, 4.6 mm; later rows curve away in the photo and read shorter
bracelet.bend_note: Smooth curl (house, from SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, links bend with the curve
bracelet.half_width_note: first row and end link both 19.8 mm in the photo (trace checks.end_link_width_mm); constant, no taper visible near the case

gold_polished.note: dark brass of the hands, index frames and day-date frame: model-viewer shows about sRGB 130/121/90 as in Irsyad's photo

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

lume.note: pale grey-green lume as photographed (about sRGB 190/195/185)

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL 1K; lines along the bracelet; bevels keep the polished material
